nodes.author: OccupyNN
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span And some of the vaccines we do have don't stop transmission or infection, just reduce the risk of hospitalisation & death.

nodes.author: paula_span
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD So you think it's too risky to have toddlers, known disease vectors, mix with elders?

nodes.author: LinsanityStrong
nodes.text: @paula_span @ClementLeeMD The elderly were the first COVID vectors, and more children would have died earlier if we followed your advice. 🤡

nodes.author: ClementLeeMD
nodes.text: @paula_span I think visiting with your grandchild is one thing, moving a childcare facility into a nursing home is separate issue altogether.

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span I go into assisted living places as a pt advocate: they are some of the loneliest places. Antidepressant Rx’s are common.  No one comes to see these people except a few family members intermittently.  I try not to let it get to me.

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span There was an Easter egg hunt this spring & many residents turned out, not just the grandparents of the children. Everyone was smiling & so happy.

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span And my great grandmother was in a SNF many years ago.  She hated it. I still get tears in my eyes remembering my buddy, my pal growing up was so unhappy. It was heartbreaking 💔 💔💔There was just no way for her to go back to her house. 😭

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span We can put the elderly into sterile bubbles, but I’m not sure that makes them happy.  The Eden Alternative brings in animals & children & has seen happier residents: https://t.co/LtUzGPjY0X

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span The UT-Houston psychiatry department does research into depression vs dementia.  Depression is a huge problem with the elderly & can be mistaken for dementia.

nodes.author: bonniesheeren
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span Oh BTW, I’m 68 & despite vaccinations, I still get URIs from my grandchildren.  If I had to isolate from them…I would definitely need major depressive therapy…I just love spending every minute with them! 👵🏻👶🏼

nodes.author: TMaritanoAquino
nodes.text: @ClementLeeMD @paula_span 🎯 This is a multiplier situation: dozens of elderly residents x dozens of toddlers = recipe for illness. It’s very different than 1 or 2 children visiting with 1 or 2 elderly in a space. If any one of either are sick, they will all be exposed.

nodes.author: Alliandre
nodes.text: @TMaritanoAquino @ClementLeeMD @paula_span Yep, it's almost like what happened in Italy at the start of the pandemic: they put covid patients in elderly homes. Just guess what happened...😒

nodes.author: TMaritanoAquino
nodes.text: @Alliandre @ClementLeeMD @paula_span I remember reading that in northern Italy, many elderly were exposed by their younger family members, who worked in the city during the week & came back to their parents/grandparents country homes on the weekends. 😔

nodes.author: Alliandre
nodes.text: @TMaritanoAquino @ClementLeeMD @paula_span That, too 😒☹

nodes.author: paula_span
